mapper.sql: e.evt_id, e.title, e.start_dt, e.end_dt, e.scope_cd, e.owner_id, u.name AS owner_name, e.dept_id, d.dept_nm, e.color, e.memo, e.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_cal_event (title, start_dt, end_dt, scope_cd, owner_id, dept_id, color, memo, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, COALESCE(#{scopeCd},'PERSONAL'), #{ownerId}, #{deptId}, #{color}, #{memo}, #{ownerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_cal_event SET title = #{title}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, scope_cd = #{scopeCd}, dept_id = #{deptId}, color = #{color}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE evt_id = #{evtId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_cal_event e LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = e.owner_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE e.evt_id = #{evtId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM gw_cal_event e LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = e.owner_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.end_dt >= #{from} AND e.start_dt <= #{to} AND ( e.scope_cd = 'COMPANY' OR (e.scope_cd = 'DEPT' AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}) OR (e.scope_cd = 'PERSONAL' AND e.owner_id = #{userId}) ) ORDER BY e.start_dt

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_cal_event e WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.end_dt >= #{from} AND e.start_dt <= #{to} AND ( e.scope_cd = 'COMPANY' OR (e.scope_cd = 'DEPT' AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}) OR (e.scope_cd = 'PERSONAL' AND e.owner_id = #{userId}) )
